description: This file declares functions and data structures for managing USB device classes in Zephyr OS, including handling endpoint transfers, calculating descriptor lengths, retrieving class contexts by various identifiers, and removing class instances.

methods.name: usbd_class_handle_xfer
methods.description: Handles endpoint transfer result for a USB device class.

methods.name: usbd_class_desc_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of a class descriptor.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_iface
methods.description: Retrieves class context by interface number.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_config
methods.description: Retrieves class context by configuration and interface number.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_ep
methods.description: Retrieves class context by endpoint address.

methods.name: usbd_class_get_by_req
methods.description: Retrieves class context by vendor request.

methods.name: usbd_class_remove_all
methods.description: Removes all registered class instances from a configuration.
